- The thermostat was set up on February 10th, after weeks of procrastinating.
- January 15th comes before February 10th, so the router came first.
- The user says "got" the router on January 15th rather than "set up", so the exact setup date is not certain. But the Wi-Fi improvement shows it was in use, and the thermostat setup was clearly later.

**Answer:** You set up the new router first (around January 15th), and the smart thermostat came later, on February 10th.
